description: This bar chart illustrates the task count for different language families across three model types: mBERT, XLM-R, and “same”. The horizontal axis represents language families, labeled “IE-Baltic”, “IE-Germanic”, “IE-Indic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Slavic”, “IE-other”, “Isolate”, “Semitic”, and “Uralic”, presented in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “task count”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10.  For each language family, there are three adjacent bars representing the task count for each model. The mBERT bars are blue, the XLM-R bars are green, and the “same” bars are light green. For “IE-Baltic”, the mBERT bar reaches approximately 9, the XLM-R bar reaches approximately 6, and the “same” bar reaches approximately 11. The tallest bars are for the “IE-Slavic” language family, with mBERT reaching approximately 35, XLM-R reaching approximately 30, and “same” reaching approximately 8. The bars are grouped by language family, with each model represented side-by-side within each group. No bars are visually emphasized.
